warnings: Only observed accounts are covered; external balances and commitments are unknown.
Recurring payments overlap category totals. Do not add both as separate expenses.
Evidence strength is a heuristic, not calibrated prediction accuracy.
Zero-activity months assume continuous export coverage after the first observed month.
Bills without merchant IDs are category aggregates, not identified providers.
Historical months are scenarios, not calibrated probabilities or guaranteed bounds.
The mean path can spread uncertain income across dates; it is not a promised payday.
Each source month repeats if the horizon crosses a month boundary; seasonal changes are not modeled.
Balances are end-of-day totals across observed accounts; intraday and individual-account shortfalls can differ.
Multiple-payment groups are replayed only on remaining dates; matching individual paid bills is not supported.
Unknown future one-off costs and external accounts are not covered. Do not use this alone to promise affordable savings.
Modeled income is a probability-weighted expectation shared by scenarios; salary uncertainty requires separate error calibration.
Calibration targets whole-path coverage on the synthetic population; distribution shifts and individual customers can violate it.
